name: Host Emulated Acceptance

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review, converted_to_draft]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/host-emulated-acceptance.yml'
      - 'packages/legacy-agent-host/**'
      - 'packages/task-change-ledger/**'
      - 'scripts/legacy-agent-host/**'
      - 'tools/owned-process-broker/fixtures/**'
      - 'tools/linux-node-exec/**'
      - 'scripts/build/buildLinuxNodeExec.mjs'
      - 'scripts/dev-with-runtime.mjs'
      - 'scripts/build/linuxNodeExec.native.test.mjs'
      - 'scripts/electron-builder/afterPack.cjs'
      - 'scripts/electron-builder/dist.mjs'
      - 'scripts/electron-builder/verifyLinuxNodeExec.cjs'
      - 'src/features/agent-backend/**'
      - 'src/features/runtime-provider-management/**'
      - 'src/features/codex-runtime-installer/**'
      - 'src/features/opencode-runtime-installer/**'
      - 'src/main/**'
      - 'src/preload/**'
      - 'src/renderer/**'
      - 'src/shared/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'

permissions:
  contents: read

# Draft PRs run finite peers and the separately declared OpenCode-only local-model lane.
# Existing native Claude/Codex gates keep their scope.
concurrency:
  # Leave the obsolete always-aggregate group after all of its matrix jobs were cancelled.
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-v2-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.number || (github.event_name == 'merge_group' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/')) && github.ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/') }}

jobs:
  offline-desktop-scenario:
    name: Offline Host Desktop (${{ matrix.platform || 'linux-x64' }}, ${{ matrix.lane }})
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        lane: [team, taskboard, skills, cross-team, collaboration, extensions, import, management, codex-login, codex, claude, claude-lifecycle, opencode, review, selection, processes]
        include:
          - lane: installer
            runner: macos-15
            platform: darwin-arm64
          - lane: opencode-v2-management
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            platform: linux-x64
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      HOST_EMULATED_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      HOST_EMULATED_LANE: ${{ matrix.lane }}
      HOST_EMULATED_PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform || 'linux-x64' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Verify original checkout and runner tuple
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$HOST_EMULATED_SOURCE_HEAD"
          node -e "require('node:assert/strict').equal(process.platform + '-' + process.arch, process.env.HOST_EMULATED_PLATFORM)"
          printf 'TMPDIR=%s\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Prepare private Linux display
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y xvfb xauth lsof
      - name: Install frozen workspace and Electron
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs --child-concurrency=1
          node scripts/ensure-electron-install.cjs --strict
          node -e "require('node:assert/strict').equal(require('electron/package.json').version, '44.10.1')"
          pnpm exec electron-rebuild --module-dir . --force --only better-sqlite3 --version 44.10.1
      - name: Build existing Desktop prerequisites and verify admission
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" = Linux ]]; then node scripts/build/buildLinuxNodeExec.mjs; fi
          pnpm --filter @agent-teams/legacy-agent-host build
          pnpm --filter agent-teams-controller build
          pnpm --filter agent-teams-mcp build
          node --test scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-backend-observations.test.ts scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-team-ui-smoke.test.ts scripts/legacy-agent-host/test-child-process-trace.test.ts scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-emulated-settings.test.ts scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-emulated-codex-catalog.test.ts scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-resume-records.test.ts scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-captured-app-exit.test.ts scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-opencode-v2-management-records.test.ts
          node --test test/scripts/installDependenciesWithRetry.test.mjs
      - name: Verify original Runtime and Team conversation contracts
        if: matrix.lane == 'team'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --test --test-concurrency=1 packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/runtime-activity.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/runtime-team-host.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/team-snapshot.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/team-product-changes.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/team-activity-read.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/member-provider-authority.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/member-process-stderr.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/codex-member-provider.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/captured-claude-process.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/owned-process-facade.test.ts
      - name: Verify complete workspace types and original typed lint scopes
        if: matrix.lane == 'team'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          pnpm lint:fast:files -- \
            packages/legacy-agent-host/src/adapters/providers/OpenCodeConfigurationSource.ts \
            packages/legacy-agent-host/src/composition/prepareTeamModelReadiness.ts \
            packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-configuration-source.test.ts \
            scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/platform.mjs \
            scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/platform.test.mjs \
            scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-emulated-collaboration-ui.ts \
            scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-native-process-ui.test.ts \
            scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-opencode-v2-management-records.test.ts \
            scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-opencode-v2-management-ui.ts \
            scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-owner-routing-availability-ui.ts \
            scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-proof-supplementary-sources.ts \
            scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-task-board-ui-smoke.ts \
            scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-task-comment-input-target.ts \
            scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-team-ui-smoke.test.ts \
            scripts/legacy-agent-host/packaged-opencode-v2-inputs.ts \
            scripts/legacy-agent-host/run-packaged-opencode-v2.ts \
            src/features/agent-backend/main/infrastructure/CapturedWindowsCustody.ts \
            src/features/agent-backend/renderer/createHostMemberSpawnStatuses.ts \
            src/features/agent-backend/renderer/createHostTeamChanges.ts \
            src/features/agent-backend/renderer/createHostTeamProvisioning.ts \
            src/features/agent-backend/renderer/index.ts \
            src/renderer/store/slices/teamSlice.ts \
            src/renderer/store/team/teamRuntimeRunAdoption.ts \
            test/features/agent-backend/capturedWindowsSelection.test.ts \
            test/features/agent-backend/hostMemberSpawnStatuses.test.ts \
            test/features/agent-backend/runtimeActivityFacade.test.ts \
            test/renderer/store/teamRuntimeRunAdoption.test.ts \
            test/renderer/store/teamSlice.test.ts \
            tools/owned-process-broker/nativeWindowsAppGate.mjs
          pnpm typecheck:workspace
          node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p test/features/agent-backend/tsconfig.json
          pnpm lint:ci:files src/main src/preload src/shared src/types --cache-location .eslintcache-main
          pnpm lint:ci:files src/renderer --cache-location .eslintcache-renderer
          pnpm lint:ci:files src/features --cache-location .eslintcache-features
          pnpm lint:mcp
      - name: Capture package-manager and Host inputs without vendor executables
        id: inputs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          selected_inputs="$(mktemp -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-emulated-ui-inputs-XXXXXX")"
          mkdir "$selected_inputs/corepack" "$selected_inputs/cache"
          printf '{"private":true}\n' > "$selected_inputs/corepack/package.json"
          pnpm --dir "$selected_inputs/corepack" add --ignore-scripts --save-exact corepack@0.36.0
          COREPACK_HOME="$selected_inputs/cache" node "$selected_inputs/corepack/node_modules/corepack/dist/pnpm.js" --version
          if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" = Linux ]]; then
            LEGACY_LINUX_CHILD_EXEC_GO=1 node packages/legacy-agent-host/scripts/buildLinuxProcessNativeArtifact.ts \
              --linux-child-exec "$selected_inputs/linux-child-exec" "$(command -v cc)" "$(command -v readelf)" \

            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-desktop-backend-*/userData/data/task-attachments/test-stopped-legacy/**
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-desktop-backend-*/native-chat-attachment-inputs/**
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-desktop-backend-*/home/Downloads/source-original.txt
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-desktop-backend-*/home/Downloads/TEST-native-chat.txt
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-desktop-backend-*/controlled-process-*.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-desktop-backend-*/process-ui-seed.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-desktop-backend-*/workspace/process-*.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-desktop-backend-*/workspace/process-*.ndjson

  offline-frontend-tests:
    name: Offline frontend tests (${{ matrix.shard }}/4)
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4]
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: '1'
      HOST_EMULATED_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      HOST_TEST_SHARD: ${{ matrix.shard }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
      - name: Verify source and capture the original Host test runtime
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$HOST_EMULATED_SOURCE_HEAD"
          echo "AGENT_BACKEND_TEST_NODE=$(node -p 'process.execPath')" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Setup the original workspace test runtime
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Prepare original test prerequisites
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y lsof
          node scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs --child-concurrency=1
          node scripts/ci/rebuild-better-sqlite3-node.cjs
          pnpm --filter agent-teams-mcp build
          pnpm --filter @agent-teams/legacy-agent-host build
      - name: Run the complete safe frontend shard
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Live subscriptions and real vendor executables are outside this finite lane.
          # Excluded files remain unqualified; the existing native gates are unchanged.
          pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --shard="$HOST_TEST_SHARD/4" \
            --exclude '**/*.live.test.*' --exclude '**/*.live-e2e.test.*' --exclude '**/*.native.test.*' \
            --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile "$RUNNER_TEMP/host-offline-tests-$HOST_TEST_SHARD.json" \
            2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/host-offline-tests-$HOST_TEST_SHARD.log"
      - name: Preserve original test results, including failures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: host-offline-tests-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}-${{ matrix.shard }}
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/host-offline-tests-*.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/host-offline-tests-*.log

  offline-desktop:
    name: Offline Host Desktop
    if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() && (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository) }}
    needs: [offline-desktop-scenario, offline-frontend-tests]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Require every original UI lane and safe frontend shard to pass
        env:
          HOST_EMULATED_MATRIX_RESULT: ${{ needs['offline-desktop-scenario'].result }}
          HOST_FRONTEND_TEST_RESULT: ${{ needs['offline-frontend-tests'].result }}
        run: |
          test "$HOST_EMULATED_MATRIX_RESULT" = success
          test "$HOST_FRONTEND_TEST_RESULT" = success
